branch_sync.why_the_usual_order_is_inverted: AGENTS.md asks for origin/main to be merged before a ledger commit. Here that order would have forced a forbidden act. While this batch ran, another session landed CORR-20260802-013 on main, renaming H-P13-001 -> H-WESO-001 and EV-P13-001 -> EV-WESO-001. This batch's Coordinator was concurrently UPDATING ledger/hypotheses/H-P13-001.yaml. Merging first therefore produces a rename-versus-modify conflict INSIDE A LEDGER RECORD, and AGENTS.md states that such a conflict is resolved by a new superseding record and NEVER by an edit that picks one side. Committing this archive first keeps it self-consistent and verifiable against its own commit diff; the collision is then handled as the superseding correction the rule prescribes, by a Coordinator, rather than by a merge resolution.
